correctness.rationale: The regular cyclic action on each edge-distance orbit forces constant barycentric coefficients; reflections preserve those same orbits, hence the C_n and D_n geometric fixed sets coincide. Connected circulants satisfy gcd(n,S)=1, and Watkins' vertex-transitive connectivity bound gives 3-connectivity for degree at least three; a coprime singleton gives a Hamiltonian cycle which is 2- but not 3-connected. The resulting orbit-complex for j=1,2 is the noncoprime Y_n and j=3 adds φ(n)/2 isolated singleton points. The prime-divisor simplex cover yields the boundary sphere for squarefree composites, a cone for nonsquarefree and empty for primes. Direct BFS deletion checks were independent through n=13, finite only.
